notes.title: December 22, 2020 Updates:
notes.content:
December 22, 2020 Updates:

notes.title: Updates - December 20, 2020
notes.content:
List of Updates for December 20, 2020:
1) Changed all music to .xm and .mod format. Program size and loading times are significantly better because of this.
2) Missiles do area of effect damage. 
3) Fixed issues related to bullets/missiles colliding with items.
4) Fixed some bugs related to the health and shield bars. Fixes will be ongoing.
5) Fixed some issues related to SAM talking during game over screen and other inappropriate times. Fixes will be ongoing for this issue.
6) Bullets now become transparent when they are too close to the camera. This will help with screen cluttering.
7) Added music to the main menu.
8) Added barrel roll controls for the keyboard.
9) Removed deprecated files related to aimers from the build.
10) Boosting at the end of the level would make the player's ship glow in the next level. This issue was fixed.
11) Made the material for the biohazard crates less bright.
12) Fixed issue related to purple bomb dropping enemies spawning into the game backwards.
13) Fixed issue with executing a barrel roll at the end of the level causing an issue in the new level.
14) The bullet trail used to go through the player's spaceship. This issue is fixed. 
15) Overall file size is reduced to ~115 MB.

notes.title: Barrel Roll!
notes.content:
Barrel roll is now working by double tapping either of the should buttons on your controller!!!

Made hit box for items larger. This means that they are slightly easier to collect.

Made hit box for the cube enemy bigger. This means that it is slight easier to shoot, but also slightly easier to crash into.

Note: Support for keyboard barrel rolls is current unavailable. This issue will be resolved in the near future.

notes.title: New Weapon Upgrade!
notes.content:
Patch Notes (December 9, 2020):
1) From level 11 onwards there is a new item that can be found. It changes the character's default attack to shoot either 3 or 5 projectiles. If the player takes damage the new weapon is disabled.

2) The way the camera moves has been changed. I'm not thrilled with how it turned out. Its probably a step in the right direction, but I'll continue trying to improve this. 

Other:
1) I'll continue putting in additional items and power-ups in order to make the game more fair and balanced.
2) Game performance may be negatively impacted by the new weapon power-ups on certain systems. Having multiple projectiles and particle systems on the screen at once can be intensive on certain systems. I'll be disabling some of the particle effects and changing some graphics settings to ensure a buttery smooth 60fps on most systems.

notes.title: Double Wide Playfield
notes.content:
The size of the playfield has been doubled. The game looks and plays a lot differently now. Some of the later levels are definitely a bit overwhelming, but with time things will be balanced properly. 

Additional Notes:
-Did a lot of work on rebalancing SAM's voice, the music and sound effects. Its not perfect, but a lot better.
-Bugfix: Pausing the game will now stop SAM's voice.
-Bugfix: Boosting at level end will not make the player invincible or continue the boost indefinitely.

notes.title: Software Automatic Mouth (SAM)
notes.content:
Some of you may have noticed that there is a talking robot in the game. I have decided to include a bit of a story inside the game to improve the entertainment quality of the game. A lot of adjustments to the audio effects and music will be coming in the near-term to improve the aural experience of Super Star Shooter 16. The story will play out in random order. Players will have to piece together what happened on their own.

For now only a very small part of the story is live in-game. However, the remainder of the story is expected to be released in the near future as well.

Special thanks to Andreas Rohdin for suggesting that I implement SAM on this project.

Another special thanks to Mark Barton for creating SAM and permitting me to use SAM on this project.

Have a fun and stay safe everybody!
